name: Encora
description:
Fetches theatrical performance metadata from https://encora.it
You must provide your own API key

versions.changelog:
## What's Changed

### New library types
- Added TV Show library support: Series = the show, Season = the tour, Episode = a recording date.
- Added Music library support: Artist = the show, Album = one recording (tour + date), Track = an Act (or the full recording, if not split).
- Four supported ID-matching conventions (ID in filename, ID in folder name, `.encora-<id>` marker, `.encora-id` file), each documented per library type in the README and shown as a live diagram in the settings page.

### Settings UI overhaul
- Rebuilt the config page as a tabbed layout (Info / API Keys / Videos - Movie / Videos - TV / Audios - Music) with collapsible sections.
- Per-field-type mapping tables letting you choose exactly which Encora/StageMedia field feeds each Jellyfin field (Overview, Tagline, Studio, Production Location).
- Click-to-insert title format variable palettes with live previews, for every title field (Movie, Series, Season, Episode, Artist, Album, Track).
- Per-library scoping: restrict matching to specific Jellyfin libraries instead of every library of that type.
- "Preserve manually edited descriptions" toggle so admin edits aren't silently overwritten.
- "Respect existing embedded title/track number/artwork" toggle for Music, so real ID3 tags and cover art aren't clobbered.

### Reliability
- Encora API rate limiting is now driven by Encora's own response headers (`X-RateLimit-*`, `Retry-After`) instead of a guessed client-side limit.
- Fetched recordings are now cached and de-duplicated by ID, so Movie/Series/Season/Episode/Artist/Album/Track items that resolve to the same Encora ID share one HTTP call instead of firing redundant requests - this also avoids inconsistent results when a subset of a large batch would otherwise hit a transient failure.
- The plugin now automatically keeps itself (and StageMedia, for Movie posters) enabled in a library's own metadata/image fetcher allow-list whenever you enable/scope that library in the plugin's settings, instead of requiring a manual step in Jellyfin's Manage Library screen.
- StageMedia poster search now also works for TV Series/Season (previously Movie-only), sharing the same show-level poster pool.
- Optional auto-refresh scheduled task to periodically re-check already-matched items for upstream Encora changes.

### Fixes
- Corrected Season/Episode ordering so items sort chronologically without showing a nonsensical date-encoded number as the season/episode index.
- Episode/Album overviews now default to notes only instead of repeating the full show description on every single date; Series/Artist still show the full show description.
- `{master}` now falls back to "Unknown" instead of vanishing when Encora has no recorder on file.
- Fixed Season/Series folder scanning to recognize DVD-sourced `.vob`/`.ifo` files.
- Various analyzer/version fixes; bumped to the Jellyfin 10.11 SDK (.NET 9).

### Breaking change
- **Requires Jellyfin `10.11.0` or later.** The plugin is now built against .NET 9 to match Jellyfin 10.11+, and will not load on older servers.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pekempy/Jellyfin.Plugin.Encora/compare/1.0.0.1...1.1.0.0

## What's Changed
* Updated readme by @KristAude in https://github.com/pekempy/Jellyfin.Plugin.Encora/pull/1
* Update README.md by @KristAude in https://github.com/pekempy/Jellyfin.Plugin.Encora/pull/2
* Refactored to remove NFOMetadataProvider separately and incorporate the logic into the Encora Provider.
* Change thumb generation to be a random time during the video (15-60% of duration) to handle shorter highlight videos

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pekempy/Jellyfin.Plugin.Encora/compare/1.0.0.0...1.0.0.1

### Initial Release
The first release of the Encora agent for Jellyfin!

#### Features:
- Fetch from Encora based on the ID
- Fetch headshots 
- Download subtitles (may need a second 'refresh' for new files after downloading)
- Customise the names of your library
- Fetch posters from stagemedia
